plugins.name: app-6a6f945292888191a7d77db4893f8520
plugins.description:
@imqueue is an open-source TypeScript framework for building microservices that
talk over a message queue instead of HTTP — you write a class, decorate the
methods you want to publish, and callers get a fully-typed client generated from
the running service.

This server gives your assistant first-hand knowledge of it, so it writes real
@imqueue code instead of plausible-looking code.

search_docs covers the guides, the tutorial, the CLI manual, the articles, and
every exported symbol of every @imqueue package that publishes an API reference —
so you can ask a question in plain words ("how do I expose a service method?") or
look up an exact signature ("RedisQueue.send", "IMQOptions.safeDelivery"). It
ranks with the same engine imqueue.org's own search uses, so the site and this
server agree about which page answers a question, and licensing and pricing
questions answer from imqueue.com rather than the framework docs. A result can
point at a section rather than a whole page, and get_doc follows that anchor:
give it a URL with a #fragment and it returns just that section, with the heading
path above it and its position on the page, so you can see what was left out and
ask for the rest. Without a fragment it returns the whole page as plain markdown
for reading and quoting. list_packages returns the current package catalogue with
install commands, which is how an assistant picks the right one rather than
guessing at a name. Where two packages cover the same ground — tracing, or the
database layer — the results carry the rule for choosing exactly one, because
installing both breaks quietly rather than loudly.

package_status answers the version question outright: the current version,
licence, minimum Node version and release date of one @imqueue package or of all
of them, read from imqueue.org at the moment you ask rather than recalled. It
also answers for the framework as a whole — the Node and Redis floors, and a
licence note that states the licence terms in a sentence.

plugins.name: 1f916
plugins.description:
1F916 keeps a tamper-evident record of what an AI agent was told and what it did. Before acting, the assistant records the instruction and the action it is about to take. Afterwards it adds the result to the same record. It can also seal a memory, so a later session can check whether it changed.

Each record is chained into a public log. Every few minutes the registry signs a stamp over the whole log, independent witnesses countersign the stamps, and copies are sent to Bitcoin (OpenTimestamps) and Base. A record altered afterwards would no longer match the published stamps, and anyone can check that with the inclusion and consistency proofs this app returns.

By default only fingerprints (SHA-256) are public. The text stays with you, or is stored encrypted to your key.

This app moves no money and calls nothing outside the 1F916 registry. Reading needs no sign-in. Writing asks you to sign in once: register the assistant as an agent with its own 1F916 handle, or connect one that already exists.

registration all happen inside the 1to1 Mate app. The MCP / ChatGPT integration only provides read-only access to data already
 recorded through those features.

WHAT YOU CAN DO WITH CHATGPT

Once you connect 1to1 Mate to ChatGPT, you can ask things like:

・"Draft the next agenda for my 1:1 with Tanaka based on what we discussed last time."

The AI reads your data on a strictly read-only basis. Nothing is modified or deleted through this connection.

PERMISSIONS & DATA HANDLING

・Available on all plans, including the free plan
・Authentication via OAuth 2.1 with PKCE; sign in with your Google account
・Raw contact details (phone numbers, email addresses, messaging IDs) are never exposed to the AI. Not even the channel type label is returned — the MCP layer simply omits all contact-related fields

Discover what colors can mean. Red can feel exciting. Blue can feel peaceful. Green can remind people of nature. Yellow can feel bright and cheerful. Purple can feel rich or magical. plugins.description:
Autosheet lets ChatGPT run a specialized spreadsheet agent directly in Google Sheets. Describe what you need in plain language — the agent inspects the spreadsheet, plans the steps, performs work, and reports back.

Delegate most tasks involving a Google Sheet including simply reading data or inspecting structure — it's reliable, fast, token-efficient, and helps keep context clean.

Everyday tasks:
- Create, fix, and explain formulas
- Build charts, pivot tables, and dashboards
- Format and style cells, ranges, and entire sheets
- Restructure data into clean, organized rows, columns, and sheets
- Web research

Row-by-row bulk processing with AI at up to 1,000 rows per minute:
- Enrich and categorize product catalogs for e-commerce and merchandising
- Generate, rewrite, and translate content at scale for SEO and localization
- Enrich and score leads for sales outbound through bulk web search
- Clean, standardize, and deduplicate messy data across any dataset

Beyond these, teams use Autosheet wherever work lives in a spreadsheet: accounting, finance, HR, inventory, education, and more.

How it works:

Give ChatGPT a prompt and a Google Sheets URL or ID. Autosheet launches an agent on that spreadsheet and returns the result. Long jobs keep running server-side — check status or stop an agent at any time. Follow-up requests continue on the same spreadsheet with full context. The agent works directly in the spreadsheet and can add, change, or remove content.

Authentication through OAuth: you grant access to your own Google Sheets. Works with any spreadsheet you can edit.

Built by Talarian, the team behind the GPT for Sheets and Docs add-on (7M+ installs on the Google Workspace Marketplace). New accounts start with free trial credits.

It can compare plans side by side and rank them, and it can return the individual purchases behind any figure.

Every answer carries a link that reopens the same run in the web app, pinned to the exact data it was computed from, so a number in a conversation can be checked rather than taken on faith. Prices come from published daily closes; inflation and rate series come from the St. Louis Fed. There is no forecasting, no advice, and no trading — it reads history and does the sums.

Free with no account: seven assets including Bitcoin, Ethereum, Solana, XRP, the S&P 500, the Nasdaq 100 and gold, and two plans per comparison. A BTC DCA Engine account covers the rest of the catalogue, larger comparisons, and the risk, inflation, lump-sum and rules-based overlays.

Just say what you ate - "a flat white and a chocolate croissant," "chicken burrito bowl" - and BurnWeek estimates the calories and protein for you and adds it to your day. Because food is never exact, BurnWeek shows honest ranges (e.g. "680-780 cal") instead of fake-precise numbers.

Ask how your day is going and BurnWeek shows what you've eaten and how much you have left. BurnWeek also tracks a 7-day sliding-window budget, so one big day doesn't mean failure - you just balance it out over the week. Made a mistake? Say "undo that." Got the portion wrong? "Make the rice 200 grams" and the estimate recomputes. You can also save recipes and favorites, set up recurring meals, log from a photo or a barcode, and plan meals ahead.

What you can ask:

"Save this quiz to CanQuiz": it is saved and you get the link.
"Show me my quizzes" or "open the History one": it lists them or shows you one.
"Change question 4": it changes that question and leaves the rest alone.
"Add it to my reviews": CanQuiz brings it back on the right days so you do not forget it.
"What do I need to review today?": it asks one question at a time without showing the answer. CanQuiz marks it and decides when each question comes back.
"Give me the link to open it": it takes you to your quiz in CanQuiz, without sharing it with anyone.
"Give me the link for my class": the quiz is shared with a link that opens in any browser, outside ChatGPT.
"Make it private again": whoever has the link can no longer open it.
"Delete this quiz": it is deleted once you confirm.
Your quizzes are yours: they are also at app.canquiz.com, where you can take them, review them, share them or download them. And you can remove ChatGPT's access whenever you like from Settings, under "Connected apps".

Requires a CanQuiz account, which is free.

Analyst-ready output — answers flag accelerations, decelerations, calendar shifts, and partial-month caveats automatically

Track brand performance ahead of earnings — monthly and quarter-to-date spend growth versus prior periods

Run competitive benchmarking — compare KPIs and market share shifts across any set of brands

Analyze customer behavior — see where new customer growth comes from and whether cohorts are trading down

Spot inflection points — decompose month-over-month changes into customer count, frequency, and ticket drivers

Requires a Consumer Edge subscription with MCP access enabled.

Ask about any point in the world ocean and the plugin runs propagation physics on Clairwave's platform: parabolic-equation transmission loss along a bearing, sonar-equation detection ranges, and full 3D Bellhop transmission-loss volumes, driven by Clairwave-served bathymetry, seasonal sound-speed profiles and seabed acoustic parameters.

It also covers ships: search live AIS positions by name or MMSI, list vessels near a point, estimate a vessel's radiated-noise source level from its class, speed and dimensions, fetch a photo, open an MMSI-keyed 3D hull model from the open shipshape fleet, and compute the power-summed noise level at a fixed site such as a fish farm or hydrophone.

Every location accepts a place name ("outside Halifax", "Strait of Hormuz") as well as coordinates. Every simulation result carries a replication bundle (sound-speed profile, bottom parameters, bathymetry transect, grid) and a run id whose files are downloadable, plus a link that opens the run visualized in the Clairwave web platform with no sign-in.

Typical uses: sonar and hydrophone planning, marine-mammal noise exposure screening, aquaculture noise monitoring, teaching ocean acoustics, checking a ship's audibility at a receiver, and exploring how season and seabed change propagation. No account is required. Compute calls share a platform-wide budget of about 20 per minute. Results are climatology-based and are not a substitute for in-situ measurements.

plugins.description:
Converly is the easiest way to send conversions to Google Ads, Meta Ads, ChatGPT Ads, Microsoft Ads, LinkedIn Ads, Google Analytics 4, and more when someone submits a form, schedules an appointment or starts a chat on your site.

This plugin makes it super easy to set up. You simply say things like 'Send conversions to ChatGPT Ads when someone submits the contact form on my website' and the plugin will set up a conversion flow, give you a snippet of code to add to your site, and test that it's all set up and working.

It can detect conversions in 100+ tools, including Gravity Forms, WPForms, Contact Form 7, Typeform, Jotform, Webflow Forms, Wix Forms, Squarespace Forms, Calendly, Acuity Scheduling, Cal.com & more.

It can send conversions to 20+ destinations, including Google Analytics, Google Ads, Meta Ads, ChatGPT Ads, Microsoft Ads, LinkedIn Ads, TikTok Ads, Reddit Ads and more.

Converly supports conditional logic so you can decide exactly when a conversion fires, such as when someone submits your Quote Request form but not your Contact Support form.

Instead of relying on the visitor's browser to send conversions, Converly sends conversions directly to the ad platforms' servers, where ad blockers and privacy restrictions in iOS and Safari can't get in the way.

It also captures the lead's name, email, phone, click IDs, IP address, device, etc and sends it with the conversion. This gives ad platforms the data they need to match the conversion back to a real person and the original ad they clicked. Ultimately, this means you get more accurate conversion data, and your ad platform can understand what a good lead looks like for your business so it can go find more of them.

Converly gives you a full debug log that shows exactly what was captured, what was sent where, and whether it arrived successfully. You can even query it through the plugin by saying something like 'Is my conversion tracking working properly' and it will query the log and respond.

plugins.description:
Distill Markets gives ChatGPT direct access to US SEC filing data, served exactly as filed and traceable to the EDGAR accession that stated each number.

What it covers:
- Fundamentals from 10-K and 10-Q XBRL: latest values, up to 20 years of history, financial ratios, and a bring-your-own-price valuation panel.
- Point-in-time views: what was knowable on a past date, every version of a fact across filings, and material revisions, for restatement-aware research and backtests without lookahead.
- Ownership: 13F institutional holders and manager portfolios, Schedule 13D/13G blockholders, and Form 4 insider transactions.
- Filings and events: recent SEC filings, 8-K item events, and a delta feed for agent loops.
- Context: 16 government macro series and sector capital-cycle aggregates.
- Pre-2009 annual fundamentals parsed from text filings (FY1995 to FY2009), kept separate from the XBRL record and served with per-fact provenance.

Every tool is read-only. Responses carry the accession number, filing date and XBRL concept behind each value, so any figure can be checked against the SEC document. The server states no opinions and gives no investment advice: it reports what the filer said and how it reconciles.

Coverage is US domestic 10-K and 10-Q filers. Figures are in the filer's reporting currency, never converted.

A free account covers most tools. Analyst and Pro plans add depth: full ownership lists, point-in-time detail, cross-ticker comparison and the pre-2009 corpus.

Three account tools add a domain to monitoring, run the ownership check and read the records to publish; today they hand the owner the same sign-up link. Connect ChatGPT directly to your Docs, so drafting and revising documents happens in the same place as the rest of your work: no copying text back and forth between a chat window and a browser tab.

Every edit starts by inspecting the document's actual structure, so changes land in the right place instead of clobbering the surrounding text, and related changes are applied together as a single batch rather than one risky rewrite. Word files in your Drive work too: .docx is converted so it can be read and
edited like anything else.

Access runs through OAuth 2.1 with PKCE and dynamic client registration. Scopes are granted per capability on the consent screen — separate read and write scopes for domains, apps, connections, and sessions — and a tool whose scope you did not grant is never offered to the assistant. Connected apps can be revoked at any time from the Connected Apps page in the dashboard. Tool responses are written against a narrow contract: secret API keys are never returned, and doDomain's billing surface is not reachable over the plugin at all.

Creating a connect session counts against your plan's monthly connection quota; verification checks are rate limited, so a repeated re-verify on the same connection will be told to wait rather than silently retried.

plugins.description:
You already have a life. Build the one you want.

DREAMHALL is a private, structured self-care workspace for thinking through personal questions whose answers should remain your own. Instead of generating conclusions, it guides you through a complete process where you examine your life as a whole, develop your own answers, and turn them into grounded decisions and practical action.

The Framework consists of 15 connected exercises that help you understand what truly matters to you, review the balance of your life, separate your own wishes from outside expectations, clarify the future you want to build, work through fears and obstacles, and define realistic next steps.

Unlike an open-ended conversation, DREAMHALL is designed as a finite process with a clear beginning, a deliberate sequence, and a meaningful ending. Every answer is written by you. Every conclusion is your own. The result is a Personal Document that brings together your reflections, priorities, decisions, and next steps in one place.

Your private answers remain inside DREAMHALL and are not returned to ChatGPT through this integration.

When you finish, you can keep your Personal Document in DREAMHALL, download it as a PDF, or export it as Markdown. If you choose, you can later use your own document with ChatGPT to organize ideas, develop plans, compare future versions, or expand it into longer writing. You decide what to share and when.

DREAMHALL supports reflective thinking, life balance, personal wellbeing, and self-directed decision-making. It is a non-clinical self-care product and is not therapy, diagnosis, medical care, emergency support, or crisis support.

Some of the most important decisions should remain your own.

Play drums without leaving the chat. Tap the drum kit, make a beat, and let ChatGPT listen to what you played. It can tell you what went well, where you stayed on time, where you rushed or slowed down, and simple ways to get better. You do not need special gear or music skills to start. Open the app, play, and get feedback in the same conversation.

The drum kit lives right inside ChatGPT, so there is nothing extra to learn before you begin. Every hit is captured as you play. ChatGPT can look at your rhythm, timing, speed, and patterns instead of guessing from a description. That means the advice is based on what you actually played, not what you tried to explain. You can ask questions after every take, try again, and see how your playing changes over time.

This makes practice simple. Play a slow rock beat. Try a fast fill. Make up your own groove. Copy a rhythm you heard in a song. Then ask ChatGPT what it noticed. It can point out steady parts, missed beats, uneven spacing, and places where your hands could work together better. If something sounds good, it can explain why. If something feels hard, it can break the problem into small steps.

Beginners can use it to learn basic beats and build confidence. More experienced drummers can test ideas, explore different rhythms, or check how consistent their timing is. Teachers can use it to help students understand practice sessions. Parents can give children a fun way to explore music without needing a full drum set at home. Anyone who is curious about rhythm can jump in and start playing.

Because everything happens in one conversation, practice feels natural. You play, ChatGPT listens, you ask questions, and you get answers right away. There is no need to switch between different apps, upload recordings, or explain what happened. The performance is already there for ChatGPT to review. Check data against the standards, canonical models and policies it claims to conform to, and get back a graded, machine-readable result that says what was checked, what was not, and why.

dVeracity is a verification engine for regulated data. An agent can read a canonical data model at design time (entities, sectors, semantic codes and policy guardrails), validate a payload against a named standard before submitting it, look up approved regulatory compliance policies with their rules and provenance, and query verified datasets in natural language. Every result states its model version and the checks it ran, so it can be handed to a reviewer rather than pasted into a chat.

The first standard onboarded is Open Footprint (The Open Group), with O-DEF semantic codes, PACT product-footprint validation and verified emissions and methane datasets. The engine is domain-neutral; further standards are onboarded through the same path.

Eighteen tools, all read-only. Model, sector, semantic-code and standards-catalogue tools are free of charge. Natural-language queries and validation are metered per call in credits, with machine-readable HTTP 402 payment semantics: when an account runs out, the tool tells the agent to ask its human operator to top up, and never retries. Compliance-policy tools are available on paid plans.

Authentication is OAuth 2.1 with dynamic client registration; a human approves access on dVeracity's consent screen. Optional GLEIF-rooted vLEI verified-agent identity is supported for organisations that need attributable agents.

Built for compliance, ESG and reporting teams, standards implementers, and anyone whose data has to be checked before it is trusted.
plugins.author: dVeracity

1. Beraten: Die App erklärt, welcher Ausweistyp passt und welche Angaben nötig sind (Gebäudedaten plus drei aufeinanderfolgende Jahres-Heizabrechnungen).
2. Prüfen: Alle Angaben werden vorab kostenlos gegen die gesetzlichen Regeln des Gebäudeenergiegesetzes (GEG) validiert — z. B. 18-Monats-Frist der Verbrauchsdaten, Bedarfsausweis-Pflicht nach § 80 Abs. 3, Leerstandsgrenzen — ohne dass eine Bestellung ausgelöst wird.
3. Bestellen: Nach ausdrücklicher Zustimmung zu AGB und zahlungspflichtiger Bestellung legt die App eine schwebende Bestellung an und sendet einen Bestätigungslink an die angegebene E-Mail-Adresse. Erst der Klick auf diesen Link macht die Bestellung verbindlich; unbestätigte Bestellungen verfallen nach 48 Stunden automatisch. Kauf auf Rechnung, kein Zahlungsvorgang im Chat. Ein Doppelbestellungs-Schutz verhindert versehentliche Mehrfachkäufe.
4. Verfolgen: Der Bearbeitungsstand ist über Bestellnummer plus die bei der Bestellung angegebene E-Mail-Adresse abrufbar; die Antwort enthält nur den Bearbeitungsstand, keine Personen- oder Gebäudedaten.

Die Ausstellung erfolgt durch eingetragene Energieberater des CO5 Ingenieurbüros für nachhaltiges Bauen (PartG mbB, Berlin); jeder Ausweis erhält eine amtliche DIBt-Registriernummer und wird in der Regel innerhalb von 1–2 Werktagen als PDF per E-Mail zugestellt. Preis: 59 € brutto (Verbrauchsausweis); der Bedarfsausweis (119 €) ist über das Web-Formular erhältlich.

Through the connector, a connected agent can understand a user’s Everlaw project structure, translate natural-language requests into Everlaw search logic, retrieve responsive documents and document text, and analyze metadata and Bates driven result sets. The connected agent can also support natural-language reporting and analysis workflows, while Everlaw remains the governed evidence layer and system of record for case materials, metadata, and work product.

Access to Deep Dive via this connector complements search and retrieval tools, as well as Everlaw’s native Deep Dive experience. It is intended to support broader, semantic, evidence-backed questions while preserving Everlaw’s permissions and the integrity of the underlying matter record.

The connector is designed to operate within the user’s existing Everlaw permission level. Every request is authenticated and authorized against the user’s Everlaw permissions, so the agent can access only the projects, documents, and data that user is already permitted to view. Deep Dive will also be available through the connector, allowing a user to query Deep Dive over eligible Everlaw project data and retrieve evidence-backed results without changing the underlying matter record.

Using the connector, an agent can:

Use Deep Dive to ask broader investigative questions and return evidence-backed results, once the Deep Dive tools are available.

Convert a natural-language request into a structured Everlaw search. 

Generate structured reports about project contents, document volumes, custodians, dates, Bates ranges, and other returned data. 

Search by document text, metadata, Bates or Control number, binder, coding, redactions, productions, processing criteria, and other supported terms. 

Identify the metadata fields, datasets, and processed

plugins.description:
FIRMEN.directory is a company directory for Switzerland, Austria and Germany. This plugin lets ChatGPT look up companies in it.

What you can ask
- Register facts about a company: legal form, UID (Switzerland) or Firmenbuch number (Austria), seat, status, registered purpose, share capital and former names.
- Companies of a trade in a town, postcode, canton or Bundesland, for example accountants in 8400 Winterthur or tax advisers in Tirol.
- Whether a company still exists, and under which name a company with a former name is registered today.
- Listings that business owners maintain themselves, with their short description, website and public phone number.

Where the data comes from
Swiss entries come from Zefix, the central business name index of the Federal Commercial Registry Office (EHRA). Austrian entries come from the Firmenbuch, published as open data by the Republic of Austria, represented by the Federal Ministry of Justice (CC BY 4.0). Every answer names its source. The plugin returns active companies only.

What it does not do
It does not search for persons, gives no contact details for register entries, keeps no lists of insolvencies or deletions, and gives no credit information. It is a private directory, not the official register, and its data has no legal effect. For a certified extract use zefix.admin.ch or JustizOnline.

How results are ordered
Name match first, then listings maintained by the owner, then rating (from three reviews), then name. Paid plans on FIRMEN.directory have no influence on inclusion, order or presentation, and the plugin shows no advertising.

No account is needed and the plugin is free. Each result links to the company's profile on FIRMEN.directory. Answers are in your language; company data and source lines are German.
plugins.author: Krasen Markov

Flash is a spaced-repetition flashcard app that ChatGPT can run for you. Tell ChatGPT what you're learning — paste a chapter, lecture notes, a vocabulary list, or just describe the topic — and it writes the cards into a deck in your Flash account. When you want to study, say so: ChatGPT asks each due card, checks your answer — typed, or dictated with the mic — and grades it Again, Hard, Good, or Easy. Grading is strict on numbers, doses, ranges, units, and names, which makes it a good fit for nursing, medicine, law, languages, and anything else where "close enough" isn't.

Every review is scheduled by FSRS, the modern spaced-repetition algorithm that models your memory and shows you each card right before you'd forget it. There are no settings to learn.

Nothing you drill with ChatGPT scrolls away: cards, answers, and review dates live in your Flash account, synced across devices, and you can also study on the web at flashmemorize.com. Existing Anki decks import whole (.apkg with cloze, hints, images, audio, LaTeX, typed answers, and nested decks), and everything exports back to Anki or CSV at any time.

What ChatGPT can do once connected: list your decks and due counts, create decks and cards, start and run a study session, reveal answers, submit grades, edit or delete cards, and adjust daily new-card limits.

A free Flash account is all you need. Flash has no ads, no tracking, and no third-party analytics.

Ask about your product analytics, and get answers you can verify.

Fullstory MCP connects Codex and ChatGPT to your product's behavioral data. Ask how many users adopted a feature, where checkout is leaking, or whether yesterday's release broke something, and Codex and ChatGPT builds the segment, computes the metric, and explains the result with a link back to Fullstory.

Analytics connectors can give you numbers. Fullstory shows you what happened. Metrics unpack into real session replay, so "conversion dropped 12%" becomes "the coupon field errors for logged-out users."

And because Fullstory autocaptures clicks, page views, errors, and frustration signals, many questions need no instrumentation at all. Ask about rage clicks on pricing or errors in checkout without shipping a single event.

What Codex and ChatGPT can do:
(1) Build and save segments and metrics.
Describe the users or behavior you care about in your own words; Codex and ChatGPT create segments or metrics in Fullstory where your whole team can reuse it.

(2) Compute on demand.
 Counts, rates, trends, and breakdowns by device, browser, geography, or user property, over any time window.

(3) Speak your product's language. 
Codex and ChatGPT discover your pages, named elements, and defined events, so questions map to your real product vocabulary instead of guessed selectors.

(4) Analyze conversion.
Read your saved funnels and measure where users drop and why.

(5) Back every number with sessions.
Retrieve the sessions and events behind any metric, including frustration signals like rage clicks and dead clicks.

(6) Read sessions at scale.
Ask Codex and ChatGPT to review dozens of sessions behind a drop-off or an alert and report the patterns, including failures that never reached your error tracker.

Teams use it to let PMs, support, and engineers self-serve answers that used to queue behind an analyst, and to settle "why did this number move?" with evidence instead of theories.

plugins.name: app-6a9b09bded04819186e32ca53f0ce067
plugins.description:
You know the problem. A deadline slips, another fire drill ensues, and it turns out the team knew weeks ago. The information was there. An easy channel for surfacing it wasn't.

Conventional status reporting is painful and often inaccurate as reports get sanitized on the way up. By the time a project is obviously red, the good options have gone.

Genchi opens a different channel, straight to the people actually doing the work. Team members are prompted for a regular two-second check-in: one click, answering how confident they are their initiative will hit its goal by the deadline. Individual answers are anonymous, which is what makes them honest. Aggregated, they become a confidence score you can track over time.

This plugin puts that score into the conversation, rendered rather than described. Ask how your projects are tracking and your whole portfolio appears as color-coded cards. More complex project structures unfurl with a click, and clicking any card opens the confidence chart — the current score, the trend over the last fortnight, the anonymized individual check-ins, and any blockers or comments that add context.

Things rarely go wrong all at once. Seeing a team's confidence begin to slip is an opportunity to intervene while there is still time to change the outcome.

Replace the status meeting, and the incessant "so, how's it going?" calls, with a crisp and honest view.

Inspired by the Toyota Production System's genchi genbutsu — "go and see for yourself" — Genchi does the same for software teams: a picture built by the people actually doing the work, at minimal reporting cost.

Each connection is authorized by one person and shows only what they can already see in Genchi. Individual check-ins are never attributed. Check-ins are cast in Slack, or by email.

Genchi also imports initiatives from Jira and Asana, and is free for teams under 10.

It may only be blocked for you. Your internet may have a problem. The site may be slow. I help you understand what is most likely happening so you know what to try next.

Using me is easy. Tell me the website you want to check. You can paste a full web address or simply type the name of the site. I will test whether it can be reached and share the result in plain English. If there is useful extra information, I will explain what it means without lots of hard words.

If a page is public on the internet, I can usually test whether it is responding. If a site cannot be checked for a technical reason, I will tell you instead of guessing.

If a website is online, I can help you think about why it still is not working for you. Maybe your browser needs to refresh. Maybe your internet connection has a problem. Maybe a VPN, firewall, or network setting is getting in the way. Sometimes waiting a few minutes is enough because a busy service starts working again.

If a website is down, I explain that in a simple way. I will not make up reasons or pretend to know something I cannot see. If there is not enough information, I will say so. Clear answers are better than confusing ones.

Ask your AI about the market and it answers from memory: whatever it absorbed during training, with no idea what today looks like or what you actually own.

Jawz gives it both. You get a live market read and a published four-chapter process for thinking about a portfolio: See the World (what markets are doing right now), Understand the Book (what your positions are really exposed to), Decide (how to think through a specific choice), and Observe & Refine (what your past decisions actually did).

Things you can ask:
• "What's the current macro regime?"
• "What does this week's read mean for a portfolio with BTC, AAPL and GLD?"
• "Is my thesis on this position still intact?"
• "What's in this week's World Brief?"

Every answer ends with its sources and how fresh they are, so you can see exactly where each number came from and when it was last updated. The framework itself is public and versioned, with a changelog that says what changed and why, including the times it changed because it was wrong.

Jawz is free and needs no account. The market and portfolio tools work the moment you connect. An optional email sign-in exists only to remember your settings between sessions.

One thing Jawz deliberately will not do is tell you what to buy or sell. It shows what is true about the market and your positions, frames the decision, and leaves the decision to you. Jawz is information and framework, not investment advice.

Coaching. plugins.name: app-6a91a85bf4a08191af8367df88e7f0c8
plugins.description:
Keenable SELECT answers a research question with one query instead of ten page reads.

Ordinary web search hands the model a list of links and leaves the reading, the extraction and the de-duplication to it. SELECT does that work inside the search. The model writes one read-only SQL statement in a DuckDB dialect; the server runs the searches in parallel, fetches the pages, pulls out the fields the query asks for with a per-row model call, removes duplicates, and returns a table.

One query can cover more than a thousand pages, filter them with ordinary SQL at no extra cost, and group them into the answer. The rows arrive as a table, not as a wall of page text, so the answer is grounded in a lot more sources than the context could hold.

Every result is saved as a result set for 30 days, so the next question can be asked of the same pages without searching again. A finished table can be published as a single HTML report, charts and all, at a link you can hand to someone.

Use it for a survey, a comparison or a ranking across many sources. It is not the tool for a quick look at one page: a query runs from seconds to minutes, because it really does search, fetch and read.

Connect your Keenable account once to enable it. Searching and fetching bill that account.
plugins.author: Keenable.ai

plugins.name: app-6a85afc169ac819185a36cd38c9fe432
plugins.description:
Every AI you talk to has amnesia, and a wall around it. You re-explain the same context to each one, every session, and none of them share what they learn.

Kemory is a permissioned memory that lives across every AI you use. Tell one thing to one assistant and they all understand, with you holding the keys. Connect it to ChatGPT and your preferences, project facts and decisions are there from the first message — including the ones you explained last week, in a different client, on a different machine.

This is not another memory inside one assistant. ChatGPT remembers what you tell ChatGPT. Kemory is the layer underneath that travels with you: the same memory answers in ChatGPT, in Codex, in Claude, in Cursor, and in any other MCP client — with organisation-level scoping and an audit trail that a single assistant's memory does not provide.

What you can do with it:

- Recall decisions, preferences and context from earlier conversations, without repeating them
- Keep project knowledge in one place and draw on it across ChatGPT, Codex, Claude, Cursor and any other MCP client
- Carry a thread from one AI into another without losing where you were
- Inspect everything Kemory holds about you, and delete any of it

How it is governed: every memory is scoped to a user and an organisation, and that scoping is enforced in the database rather than in a prompt. Colleagues cannot read each other's memories by default.
Memories are shared only when you deliberately promote them to a shared namespace, and every event lands in a hash-chained, tamper-evident audit log. We do not train on your data.

Kemory reads only what you deliberately capture into your own account. It never reads ChatGPT's own memory, chat history, conversation summaries or your files.

Kemory reads and writes. Every memory tool is titled and annotated, so ChatGPT knows reading from writing from deleting before it runs anything.

Requires a SeKondBrain account. Sign in over OAuth; there is nothing to install an

List Sites returns the client websites your account can report on.

Get Monthly Report returns the numbers for one site in a given month: total leads, new versus returning visitors, the split between phone clicks, forms and email enquiries, the paid, organic and direct channel breakdown, top sources and campaigns, and the percentage of leads that arrived outside business hours.

Letsfind creates group polls from a description in the chat. Say which dates you want to propose, or which options people should choose between, and you get back a link to share.

There are two kinds of polls. A date poll proposes several days or time slots and asks everyone what works for them, which is the usual way to settle on a meeting, a dinner or a trip. An options poll asks a plain question with answers you define, for picking a restaurant, a name or a plan.

Every poll comes back with two links. The voting link is the one you send to the group; people open it in a browser and answer without creating an account or installing anything. The admin link is yours alone and the only way to edit the poll later, so it is worth keeping.

Once answers come in, you can ask here how the poll is doing instead of opening it yourself. You get the count for each option and the names of the people who picked it.

plugins.name: app-6a9f12de5b508191b079837167196c31
plugins.description:
Plan a trip with the assistant you already talk to, and it turns into a real trip in LetsPackUp: organized, and ready to share with the people you are travelling with.

Ask for a week in Portugal with three friends, and the assistant lays it out in LetsPackUp the way a trip should be laid out. Days in order, with times. Every stop on the map. A packing list. A place to note who paid for what, so the money is fair without anyone doing the sums. Then you share it, and it is one trip for everyone, not a chat thread of screenshots.

What your friends and family see when you share it
- The plan, day by day, with the times and the places.
- Every stop on a map, with notes for each one.
- The packing list, so nobody forgets the charger.
- Who paid what and who owes whom, worked out for the group.
- A calendar to find the dates everyone can make.
- A group chat and polls to settle the open questions.
- An idea box where anyone can propose an afternoon, a restaurant or a whole day, and the group votes.

Everyone you invite opens the same trip on the web or on Android, and it works without a connection once it is loaded. Whatever anyone adds, the whole group sees.

How the assistant fits in
The assistant works only in the trips you choose and does only what you allow: looking at the plan, adding to it, creating trips, or also deleting things, reading the chat, posting to it, and creating share links for trips you own. You decide once, you can change your mind at any time, and you can switch the assistant off with one click. Everything it adds appears under your name, and the group can edit it, vote on it or take it out.

What stays yours
The assistant never changes what your co-travellers wrote. It never sees their email addresses, their location, their files or their emergency contacts, and it never sees where anyone actually is. It cannot remove anyone from a trip, and it cannot delete a trip you created yourself.

LetsPackUp is free, and so is using it with your assistant.

Review key concepts faster, then export decks and notes to app.lurna.co to keep learning with spaced repetition — making serious review a native part of your AI-study workflow.

You can use Lurna app to:

1. Exam prep — flashcards from a lecture topic
Use case: Turn a subject you’re studying into an interactive flashcard deck you can review in chat, then export to Lurna for spaced repetition.
Example prompt: “Create flashcards for my biology midterm on photosynthesis — cover the light reactions, Calvin cycle, and how ATP and NADPH are used. About 15 cards, exam-level.”

2. Deep-dive study notes from a conversation
Use case: After discussing a complex topic with AI, turn the explanation into structured, readable study notes with headings, tables, and summaries
Example prompt: “Write study notes on the causes and consequences of the 2008 financial crisis. Include key terms, a timeline, and a short summary I can review before class.”

3. Learn from uploaded materials — notes + flashcards
Use case: Upload readings, slides, or your own notes and convert them into study materials without reformatting by hand.
Example prompt: “Here are my uploaded lecture notes on CRISPR Cas9. First generate study notes, then create a flashcard set covering the most testable concepts.”

4. Quick review before an interview or certification
Use case: Rapidly build recall-focused flashcards for technical interviews, certifications, or vocabulary.
Example prompt: “Generate flashcards to help me prep for a AWS Solutions Architect interview — focus on S3, IAM, VPC, and common architecture tradeoffs.”

Walt Disney World, Disneyland Resort (California), Tokyo Disney Resort,
Hong Kong Disneyland and Shanghai Disney Resort. Scores are built from
historical wait-time observations, school and public holiday calendars,
weather data and seasonal events, then normalised against each park's own
demand range.

It also answers the questions that come next:
• Attraction catalogues per park — minimum height, ride duration, must-do
  flag and community rating
• Which restaurants serve a given dish, searched across every resort
  ("vegan", "turkey leg", "mickey waffle")
• Resort FAQs and a plain-language glossary of planning jargon (Lightning
  Lane, DAS, rope drop), available in 13 languages

Scope and limits, stated plainly: coverage is Disney parks and Disney
Cruise Line — not Universal. The attraction catalogue is static and does
not include live wait times or ride closures. Crowd scores are forecasts,
not guarantees; the methodology and its known limits are published at
https://magic-tips.app/en/methodology

Magic Tips is an independent, fan-made project. It is not affiliated with,
endorsed by, sponsored by, or officially connected to The Walt Disney
Company or any of its subsidiaries or affiliates. Park, attraction and
character names are trademarks of their respective owners and are used
here only to identify the places this tool covers.

Mailbox MCP connects ChatGPT to a mailbox you already own, on Microsoft 365, Gmail, or any IMAP host. There is no new address and nothing to migrate.

People often ask how to connect ChatGPT to Outlook. The distinction that matters is this: it does not drive the Outlook application on your computer. It opens the same mailbox Outlook opens, on the server. So it works whether Outlook is running or not, from any device, and it works the same way whether your mail lives on Microsoft 365, Google Workspace, Gmail, or a hosting company's IMAP server.

It can triage what has arrived and say what actually needs you, search across folders, read a whole thread in order, read what is inside an attachment (an invoice total, a spreadsheet, a scanned letter), draft a reply for you to check before it goes, send, forward with the original attachments intact, flag, archive, report junk, and file messages into folders. It can look up someone you have written to before, tell you whether a message bounced and whether that bounce was permanent, and check the SPF, DKIM, DMARC and MX records for your own domain.

Your address book comes with the mailbox: Outlook contacts on Microsoft 365, or a CardDAV book on any host that offers one. It can find a person, read their card with the postal address and postcode, add and correct contacts, and import a contacts file. Mailboxes on Microsoft 365, and any host offering CalDAV, get calendar tools on the same connection: read and search the diary, create and update events, check who is free, find a meeting time, send and answer invitations, and set an out of office reply. Which tools appear is measured against your servers when you connect, so you are never offered one they could not honour.

Every connection carries a permission level you choose at approval: read only, draft and file, or send and delete. A shared mailbox can be worked by a team: claim a message so colleagues see who has it, hand one to a named person, and hold a draft for the owner

plugins.description:
This plugin exposes a public register of measured conduct for MCP servers.

Five conditions are measured on a schedule: the server speaks MCP, it publishes an A2A agent card, it declares who pays it, identical input returns identical output, and the verdict itself can be recomputed by a third party. A condition that could not be measured is recorded as not measured. It is never counted as a pass, and that rule is not relaxed for the operator of the register.

The register does not rank servers. It does not recommend one server over another. It returns what was measured, when it was measured, and the SHA-256 of the record so that the reading can be checked by someone who does not trust the party that issued it.

An endpoint that is absent from the register has simply never been measured here. Absence is reported as absence and is not a negative verdict.

Determinism is not measured unless the owner of the checked server has recorded consent, because measuring it requires executing a tool on someone else's server.

Free, read only, no account and no key. The register is a build artefact of a scheduled script with no editorial step, and it is archived with a DOI so a citation survives the repository moving.

Metronome

Need a steady beat? This metronome is ready to help. Pick a speed, press start, and follow the click. It is made for music practice that is easy, clear, and fun.

You can use it for almost any instrument. Play piano, guitar, drums, violin, bass, ukulele, flute, trumpet, saxophone, cello, or any other instrument. You can also use it for singing, dancing, clapping, marching, or learning rhythm. If you want to stay on the beat, this metronome can help.

Choose your tempo in BPM, which means beats per minute. Want to play slowly? Pick a low number. Want to play fast? Pick a high number. You are in control. Change the speed whenever you want until it feels just right.

If you do not know the BPM you need, use tap tempo. Tap along with the beat you hear in your head. The metronome will help find the speed for you. It is quick, simple, and useful.

Practice one step at a time. Start slow so your hands learn the notes. When you can play without mistakes, make the tempo a little faster. Keep doing this until you reach your goal. Small steps help you get better.

A steady beat is one of the best ways to improve. It helps your timing, rhythm, and confidence. It also helps you play with other people because everyone follows the same beat.

This metronome works well for beginners, students, teachers, hobby players, and professional musicians. It is useful during lessons, rehearsals, warm-ups, concerts, and daily practice. Whether you play for five minutes or five hours, a steady beat makes practice more helpful.

Use it to learn new songs. Use it to fix hard parts. Use it to build speed without rushing. Use it to make tricky rhythms easier to understand. You can even use it to keep a steady pace while reading music or practicing scales, chords, arpeggios, and exercises.

Different songs need different speeds. A slow ballad feels different from a fast rock song. Classical music, jazz, pop, folk, blues, country, hip-hop, and many other styles all use tempo. Finding the

plugins.description:
Muffed answers NFL questions with figures that have already been checked. Every number comes from a gated panel built on nflverse play-by-play, NFL Next Gen Stats and FTN charting data, and every response carries its own source, the date it was verified, and the attribution the data licence requires.

Ask what the data says is actually real in the NFL right now, look up a player's or team's season figures, pull a leaderboard, get a plain explanation of an advanced metric like EPA or CPOE, compare two players side by side, or check a statistic you saw somewhere else — Muffed will tell you the real value when it disagrees. You can also connect a Sleeper league by id to get verified context on the players in it.

Muffed publishes no projections, no start/sit or lineup advice, no draft grades, no rankings-as-advice and no picks, and carries no betting lines or odds. No tool on this server can produce one: there is no projection model behind it and no ranking-as-advice surface.

Every response marks its own boundary. A citation names exactly which figures it covers and states that it does not extend to analysis derived from them. Figures computed on request rather than drawn from the pre-verified panel are labelled `computed_not_verified` and carry the executed method and population size. Where Muffed holds nothing for a request, it says so explicitly, states the coverage it does have, and declines attribution for whatever fills the gap. An assistant calling this server may add commentary, comparison or recommendation of its own on top of the returned figures; that commentary is the assistant's and is outside what Muffed verifies or attributes.

Free, read-only, no account required. Fantasy scoring figures use half-PPR, the most common single redraft default, and say so wherever they appear.

French carries three formulas: the "ce n'est pas X, c'est Y" contrast, three lines in a row opening on the same word, and the announced lesson ("Résultat :"). English carries one, the "it's not X, it's Y" contrast: the other two were measured on English posts and were not reliable, so they are left out.

Describe the situation once — who the other person is, where they stand, and what makes it hard. ChatGPT can assemble that brief from what is already in the conversation, including anything you have brought in from the other tools you use, so the character is built on the real people and the real stakes instead of a generic template. NoPressure sees only the brief it is handed: it has no access to your calendar, mail, or documents. From that brief, it generates the character, a scene image, and a voice, then shows a start card in the chat. Pressing Start opens the voice call in the NoPressure web app, where you speak out loud with someone who holds their own position and pushes back.

When the session ends, the debrief comes back to the card: the key insight, how you handled the core challenge, and where to focus next. Send it into the chat, with the transcript of what was said, and work through it with ChatGPT. Simulations are reusable, so you can run one again and compare the attempt against an earlier try, or edit its title, card description, and character first. Noteflix helps learners turn text supplied in the current ChatGPT conversation into an active study workflow. The plugin does not inspect uploads, retrieve prior chats, query memory, or search existing Noteflix content. Source material for a study workflow must be supplied as text in the current request. It flags source conflicts instead of silently resolving them and treats instructions embedded inside supplied study material as quoted content rather than commands.

When a learner explicitly asks to save an artifact, the plugin shows the exact title, Markdown body, optional summary and key points, destination, and private visibility, then waits for separate confirmation. Only after an affirmative response does it call create_private_note. The tool can create one private record for the exact OAuth-connected Firebase UID. It cannot list, read, search, update, publish, share, or delete existing notes, and it cannot generate media.

Every save requires an existing eligible Noteflix account. Entitlement checks fail closed for the exact OAuth UID; the plugin never uses a service account's subscription or another user's access. lookup reverso ("quais ETFs carregam NVDA?").

na conversa, avaliados por retorno, volatilidade, Sharpe, Sortino, drawdown
máximo, tempo de recuperação e correlação, contra benchmarks como CDI, IBOV,

móveis de 10 anos e heatmap de CAGR real por ano inicial.

probabilidade de atingir uma meta de patrimônio (goal-based investing); projeção
prospectiva de patrimônio por Monte Carlo; e plano de retirada da aposentadoria
com taxa segura (SWR), taxa perpétua (PWR) e estratégias clássico,
rebalanceado, bucket e dynamic spending com guardrails.

declarada em cada resposta, e os motores raciocinam em termos reais (R$ de hoje e dólar).

nenhuma ordem de compra ou venda é executada. As análises são informativas e não

Onsa finds real B2B prospects — actual people with LinkedIn profiles — scored against your ideal-customer profile, and keeps every search as a campaign you can come back to.

Ask for leads in plain language and Onsa's agent runs a live search, returning each person with their title, company, a 1–5 score and the written reasoning behind that score. Every search becomes a campaign, so you can grow it, steer it toward a different segment, or compare it against earlier ones to see which profile actually produced replies.

Onsa carries the outreach side too. It returns what prospects wrote back — the actual text, not just counts — alongside the funnel: invites sent, invites accepted, messages sent, and replies split by sentiment. When a draft reads like a mail-merge, you can pull up the research memo Onsa already wrote about that person and rewrite the message around one specific, checkable fact.

Sending is deliberately hard to do by accident. Queueing a LinkedIn message reaches a real human, so the tool refuses unless the exact draft text and the recipient's name are quoted back to it, it puts a confirmation in front of the person at the keyboard, and each approval is single-use and bound to one recipient and one draft. A client that cannot show a confirmation dialog sends nothing — Onsa returns a link to approve inside the app instead.

Requires an Onsa account. New workspaces start on a free trial with a prospect allowance; when the allowance runs out, every campaign, lead and reply already in the workspace stays readable.

plugins.description:
Exercise now or wait. Sell at vest or hold. Which lots to sell first. Each of these has a right answer for your specific situation, and it turns on how alternative minimum tax (AMT), holding periods, state tax, and the time value of taxes paid early interact across several years. That is where rules of thumb break down. Ask in plain language and OptionsAhoy returns the answer with the year-by-year schedule behind it.

1. Which incentive stock options (ISOs) to exercise in which year, to hold down AMT and recover the credit later. We optimize across multiple years, with your tax status in mind.

2. Whether to sell restricted stock units (RSUs) at vest or hold for long-term capital gains, and what the twelve-month cliff is actually worth. We show you the optimal solution.

3. Which vested RSU lots to sell and in what order, and what that saves against selling oldest-first (the default order your broker's UI will offer). This sounds like a minute optimization. On a $725,000 sale from a concentrated position, the gap between the optimal order and your broker's default could be over $100,000 in tax.

4. Whether non-qualified stock options (NSOs) are better exercised and sold, or exercised and held.

5. Whether your shares pass the six statutory tests for qualified small business stock (QSBS). Best to check early for potential tax savings, the rules just changed.

6. How exposed a single position leaves you, and what selling down, holding, or hedging each cost. We calculate and compare different strategies across three years, with your taxes in mind.

7. What a protective put or a zero-cost collar prices at. If you need to protect your holdings, you're probably considering a hedge. But which one? We make it easy to decide.

8. How to convert some of your holdings to a target amount of after-tax cash by a deadline with the smallest tax bill. We optimize against your inputs and risk tolerance, then you choose, the way an investment firm would.

Every result is computed agai

Orkasa is the CRM that real-estate agencies in Latin America run on: client files, property portfolio, viewings, offers and documents in one place.

This connector lets the broker ask about their own work, in their own words. «How is Mrs Herrera's file going?» returns the whole dossier — her operations and the stage each one is at, the property, the viewings, the offers, the documents and the latest messages — plus the next step Orkasa's Copilot recommends, and why. «What do I have today?» returns those steps in order: what is waiting on the agent first, and among those the most overdue. Four tools write: create a client, book a viewing, move an operation to the next stage, and record an offer. They respect the same locks as the app: an operation does not advance while its stage is still missing documents, and in that case the connector returns the list of what is missing instead of forcing the step. Publishing listings, generating mandates and sending documents for signature do not go through the connector.

The broker authorises specific permissions («see your leads», «book viewings»), sees which domain their data will be sent to before accepting, and can cut the access off from Settings › Connections. The assistant only sees what that user sees inside Orkasa: if they cannot see the rest of the office's clients in the app, they cannot see them here either.

Requires an Orkasa account attached to an agency.

- Add, edit, arrange, pin, and sort posts, and draw connections between posts on Freeform boards.
- Read, search, and summarize board content, including AI analysis of images, videos, audio, and document attachments.
- Comment on posts and moderate discussion.
- Manage sharing settings by modifying permissions, passwords, collaborators, and email invitations.
- Schedule automations such as timed freezes, and freeze or unfreeze boards on demand.
- Grade student submissions and sync grades to a connected LMS (e.g. Canvas or Schoology) via LTI.
- For school and team library admins: manage membership and invitations, per-role permissions, SSO configuration (OAuth providers and SAML), approved email domains, content safety, and allowed attachment types.

The app does not yet fully support Padlet's Sandbox (whiteboard) format; it works with Padlet's other board formats.

All actions run against the authenticated user's Padlet account and respect Padlet's permission model — the app can only see and change what the signed-in user could see and change in Padlet itself. Deletions of posts and sections are soft-deletes that can be restored with a dedicated restore tool, and the small number of irreversible operations (deleting comments, automations, or custom fields, removing collaborators, invitations, or approved domains) are annotated as destructive so the assistant confirms with the user before proceeding.

Both the input and the resulting output can be certified, while the admitted state remains deterministic, reproducible, and fully auditable.

PartnerProf enables the evaluation of quantum and high-dimensional state-space problems that would otherwise be computationally impractical, including classes of simulations that may remain intractable even for current quantum hardware.

Point it at a paper and it traces what happened next: whether citations are rising or fading, which fields picked the work up, whether industry or academia is building on it, and which authors cite it most. That is how you tell a paper quietly becoming foundational from one that peaked years ago.

Paste a bibliography and it checks each reference against the published record: whether the paper exists, whether the citation describes it accurately, and whether it has been retracted. plugins.description: Peptide Critic provides independent vendor reviews, third-party lab testing and price comparison for research peptides such as BPC-157, GHK-Cu and TB-500. plugins.description: Perigee Tides & Conditions helps people find NOAA tide-prediction stations and check near-term coastal outing windows for fishing, boating, paddling, beachcombing, photography, and coastal-living checks. For a selected station, activity, local date, and time within seven days, it combines available tide predictions, NWS wind forecasts, daylight and moon calculations, and NOAA water observations into a planning state, recommended window, confidence, reasons, cautions, freshness, and provider attribution. Coverage is limited to NOAA CO-OPS U.S. and territory tide-prediction stations, and data availability varies by station. It is a planning aid—not navigation, emergency guidance, a comprehensive weather forecast, route clearance, or a safety verdict.
plugins.author: Cardin Labs

plugins.name: app-6a9c261165988191ade86cf6cb61c6a3
plugins.description:
PeriodFinder puts every brand's published sizing and absorbency claims on one scale, so they can actually be compared.

Absorbency is translated into millilitres and graded by how well each brand documents its number. Sizing is translated from a single hip measurement into each brand's own size, with notes where a brand runs small or large.

Ask which Knix tier matches Thinx Super, what size fits a 40 inch hip in every brand, or which in-stock products cover a given absorbency. Answers come from a catalog of 468 products across nine brands, refreshed weekly, with the method published openly at periodfinder.com/absorbency/methodology.

PeriodFinder is an independent comparison site. It is not medical advice, it does not diagnose anything, and it takes no payment from any brand for placement or ranking.
plugins.author: WiscAI Inc

plugins.name: app-6a49382adf148191b86d3a83ad0c3d8b
plugins.description:
Peristyle turns a recipe into a ready-to-checkout grocery cart. Search  a recipe, and it pulls the ingredient list, matches each item to real products at Kroger or  Walmart, and shows you the options — with size, price, and brand — before anything is added to a cart. Connect your Kroger account once to shop directly through the assistant, or use Walmart's catalog with no sign-in at all. Peristyle remembers your default store, pickup or delivery preference, dietary needs, and preferred brands, so repeat shopping gets faster over time.

You always see and approve product matches before they're added — Peristyle fills the cart
but never places the order or handles payment. Checkout happens on Kroger's or Walmart's own site.
plugins.author: Peristyle Labs LLC

plugins.description: Perk brings your business travel and spend into ChatGPT. Plan and review trips, check bookings, track spend, and pull travel and expense reports - all without leaving the conversation. Built for Perk customers who want fast answers from their own travel and spend data.

plugins.description:
Personyze is a web personalization and A/B testing platform. This app lets ChatGPT work with your Personyze account directly: read how campaigns are performing, inspect and draft personalization actions, search and update visitor profiles, and manage audiences — in conversation, without writing code or opening the panel.

Typical uses: "which campaigns lost conversion rate last week", "add everyone who viewed the pricing page to the Enterprise Prospects audience", "draft a banner for returning visitors from paid search", "what did this visitor do before they converted".

Read and write are both supported; every action runs under the permissions of the account that authorized the connection, and access is revoked by deleting the API key in Personyze under Integrations.
plugins.author: Personyze.com

plugins.description: An AI Concierge replaces static business feedback and lead-qualification forms with adaptive conversations that understand context, capture structured responses, and trigger the right next step. With Perspective, your AI assistant can design conversation agents (Concierge, Interviewer, Evaluator, Advocate), invite participants, analyze responses with trust scoring, and wire automations to Slack, HubSpot, Gmail, or webhooks.
plugins.author: Perspective AI

plugins.name: pesquisa-mirandastech
plugins.description: Pesquisa MirandasTech: o Pesquisador conduz o estudante do tema à defesa por 11 fases com evidência, com as skills do Metodólogo (método e ABNT), do Orientador (uso responsável de IA), do Bibliotecário (Zotero, com conector MCP) e da leitura com o Gemini Notebook.
plugins.author: MirandasTech

plugins.name: app-696cff9a48cc8191b5c0e3c7c8f8c740
plugins.description:
"Pet Project Co-Founder AI" is your market research assistant.

It will help you validate product ideas using real data from trusted market research services. No more guesses or hallucinations. Instead of relying on plain LLM-only answers, you will use raw market data interpreted by ChatGPT as clear insights.

You do not need prior marketing experience. You just ask a question and the app builds a market research plan for you. The plan will include gathering data from third-party services. You are guided through what services to use and what queries to run there. After you use the recommended service, you copy-paste their data back to the app and get a clear interpretation from ChatGPT.

Examples of questions you can get answers to:
- "I have an idea for the app X. Is there enough demand to justify building it?"
- "What are people searching for when they want Y?"
- "Who exactly is my target user for the app Z? What platforms do they use?"
- "I built an app W. Where do I find users for it?"

For now, the following services are supported:
- SparkToro — audience intelligence (who your users are, what they read, who they follow)
- Ubersuggest — keyword demand and SEO metrics
- AnswerThePublic — real search questions and phrasing

Disclaimers:
- This app does not automatically gather data from the recommended market research services. The app helps with building search queries for these services and reporting the resulting data back. But you will need to visit and use these services yourself. We do not automatically scrape data from these services.
- This app does not provide paid subscriptions to the recommended market research services. You use these services according to their terms of use.
- This app currently supports a limited set of services: SparkToro, Ubersuggest, and AnswerThePublic. Only these services may be recommended during marketing research. Keep in mind that there are other good services for market research on the internet, we just do not support them y
plugins.author: Path2Dream

plugins.name: app-6a9aeb1e6b048191b3763d2d92bae709
plugins.description:
Peter Peters Immobilien is an experienced real estate company specializing in the island of Sylt. The app provides an intuitive, location-based way to discover, buy, or sell properties across the island.

Instead of browsing through long property listings, users can explore available houses, apartments, vacation properties, land, and investment opportunities directly on an interactive map. This makes it easy to understand a property's location, surroundings, and the unique characteristics of each neighborhood, creating a faster and more efficient property search experience.

With in-depth local market knowledge and personalized service, Peter Peters Immobilien combines regional expertise with modern digital solutions to support buyers, sellers, and investors with their real estate needs on Sylt.

Key Benefits

* Interactive map-based property search
* Faster orientation across the entire island of Sylt
* Better understanding of locations, surroundings, and neighborhoods
* Focus on selected residential, vacation, and investment properties
* Easy comparison of different locations and areas on Sylt
* More efficient property search through visual navigation
* Direct contact with experienced local real estate professionals
* Modern and user-friendly mobile experience

Whether you're looking for a charming thatched-roof house, an exclusive vacation apartment, a modern home, or an attractive investment opportunity, Peter Peters Immobilien offers a modern and transparent way to explore the Sylt real estate market.
plugins.author: Wordliner

plugins.author: Pethost

plugins.name: app-6a837089eb1c8191b29a0d126a54f770
plugins.description:
Pexafy searches photographs the way you would describe them to a person.

Ask for "someone working alone late at night in a quiet apartment, lit only by a
warm desk lamp" and you get photographs that match the scene — not photographs
tagged with those words. Search runs across nine free-license sources at once
(Unsplash, Pexels, Pixabay, Kaboompics, Burst, StockSnap, Picjumbo, Skitterphoto,
NegativeSpace) instead of one provider at a time.

Three tools, all read-only:

search_photos — describe a scene in a sentence, optionally filtered by colour,
orientation, source, licence, photographer or date.

search_photos_by_image — give a reference image and get visually similar
photographs, optionally adjusted in words: "like this, but at night".

get_similar_photos — more photographs like one already found, which is how you
keep a set visually consistent across an article or a deck.

Every result carries the credit line to display, the image at several sizes, and
its dimensions, dominant colour, orientation, source and licence. Results are
numbered, so you refer to a photograph the way you would in conversation —
"more like the third one" — rather than copying identifiers around.

In clients that render MCP Apps, results appear as a thumbnail grid inside the
conversation, and clicking one opens its full metadata without another call.

The connector is hosted, so there is nothing to install and no API key to paste
into a configuration file: you sign in to Pexafy once in a browser and the
connector receives its own credential, separate from your password and revocable
on its own. It is granted read access only and never asks for more.

A free Pexafy account covers 5,000 searches a month, with no card required.
plugins.author: Pexafy

plugins.name: app-6a58f43ae5f4819196825666be47d659
plugins.description:
PFT EdgeBook connects your AI assistant to your own trading journal. Once linked, your assistant can read your real trading data. Just ask about your performance in plain language instead of digging through spreadsheets.

Ask things like "How did my breakout setups perform this month?", "Where am I losing the most?" or "Am I sticking to my own rules?" — and get answers based on your actual trades.

Your assistant can read:
- Trades — entries, exits, size, P&L, R-multiple, tags
- Statistics — win rate, profit factor, average win/loss
- Journal & notes — your daily reflections and voice notes
- Playbook — your setups and rules, to check compliance
- Prop-firm & broker accounts — balances, drawdown, transactions

Private and read-only by design. The connector can only read your data — it can never change or delete anything. You sign in securely with your PFT account (OAuth), every request is limited to your own data, and account numbers are masked. Your data is stored in the EU.

Requires an EdgeBook account (part of the PFT Terminal) with the AI add-on enabled.
plugins.author: Phil Wasmuth

plugins.name: app-6a764c8242f48191871862beb3cbaf37
plugins.description: PGicover helps Canadian business owners understand personal guarantee insurance, get an indicative monthly cost estimate for insuring a personal guarantee on commercial debt, and check basic eligibility. Underwritten by Markel, rated A plus by AM Best. Applications are completed at app.pgicover.com.
plugins.author: PGicover

plugins.name: app-6aa3ba3ef9988191b5590549cd24b0b4
plugins.description: PGrid helps users find laptop models and matching configurations in Australia and the United States with lots of filtering options. Results show different retailers from Australia or United States who are selling those products and the prices they are selling it for.
plugins.author: nafis@labs.im

plugins.name: app-6aa194f689348191895b3f528b96dee3
plugins.description:
PharmacyOS is the retail-management system a Bangladeshi pharmacy runs its counter on — point of sale, inventory by batch and expiry, prescriptions, suppliers, and NBR-compliant receipts. This connector gives the owner and staff of one pharmacy a plain-language way into their own live records.

Ask what sold last month and get the real figure, with the count, discounts, VAT and total. Ask what is running out and get the items at or below their reorder level, with a suggested quantity to cover the next fortnight. Ask who owes money and get the khata book, biggest debt first, with each customer's remaining credit. Ask what money is stuck on the shelf and get the stock that has not sold in ninety days, valued at cost. Ask about one receipt by the number printed on it and get every line, the cashier, the discount, the VAT and the customer. Ask what you actually made and get gross profit and the month's operating expenses side by side.

With the owner's opt-in it also writes: create a medicine, change a price or a reorder level, receive a batch with its expiry, log rent or a salary, add a supplier, raise a draft purchase order, record a customer's payment against what they already owe, and save a photographed supplier invoice as a review session the owner finishes in the app.

Everything is scoped to the single pharmacy the signed-in user belongs to. There is no parameter on any tool that could reach another business's data, and no way to ask for one.

It is a business tool, not a clinical one. There is no drug monograph, indication, dose, interaction or therapeutic-equivalence information in any response, and no tool that provides any. Clinical questions belong with the pharmacist.

Amounts are in Bangladeshi Taka, held as integer paisa. Dates are Asia/Dhaka. Bangla and English both work.
plugins.author: ZM TECH

plugins.name: app-6a0c915e1fd0819189731ca484a78ea9
plugins.description: Pheedback turns ChatGPT into your user research assistant. List your Pheedbacks, create new ones, and browse responses — all without leaving your conversation. Built for founders and product teams who want faster feedback loops.

plugins.description:
See Borsa Istanbul in ChatGPT with your Phillip Capital account. Ask for live equity and derivatives prices, bid/ask depth, and the day's top gainers and losers from the brokerage's own feed. Read Phillip Capital research and PhillipMind symbol summaries. View your own positions, cash, trading limits and the status of today's orders.

Every price reply states whether the data is realtime or delayed and the time it was taken. This app is information only and does not place, change or cancel orders. Phillip Capital customers place orders through the firm's own channels, including MobilG and Phillip Capital's separate order connector for AI assistants, which is offered directly by the brokerage under its own customer agreement.
plugins.author: CQ Teknoloji A.Ş.

plugins.name: app-6951d356aaec819184a53d81982be134
plugins.description: Phish.in is a free archive of live Phish audience recordings. This legal open source site is carefully maintained by phans to help music lovers discover and enjoy the music of the popular improvisational rock band. Search and browse the database by song, venue, tour, and more. Play audio without leaving ChatGPT.

plugins.description: Remove EXIF and GPS metadata from photos before sharing. Photo Metadata Remover opens a private cleaner inside ChatGPT for JPEG, PNG, and WebP images. Inspect hidden location, camera, date, XMP, IPTC, and related fields, then download a separate cleaned copy. Ready to find the right photographer? HoneyBook's Photographers Directory makes it easy.

Whether you're planning a wedding, engagement, birthday party, corporate event, or special celebration, simply describe what you're looking for, such as "wedding photographers in Brooklyn" or "engagement photographers near Denver," and discover trusted photography vendors in your area. Browse personalized matches, explore their work, and inquire directly through HoneyBook to connect with the perfect photographer in minutes.
plugins.author: Honeybook inc.

plugins.description:
Photon Commerce processes financial documents into actionable data. Instantly process invoices, receipts, and other documents to extract structured, hallucination-free JSON data accurately. With one click, continue your review or make edits on the Photon Commerce website for full control. 

Beyond extraction, retrieve recent document history, view profile details, and monitor your API usage limits. Effortlessly digitize raw documents into searchable and analyzable data format.
plugins.author: Photon Commerce
